verdict.rationale: Published storage pricing is a fair question for a cloud storage product, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party pricing page, per-plan quotas, per-user prices, or documented over-cap behavior. Community remarks about a free tier, 1TB of storage, or running out of space are anecdotes, not a published pricing page, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, storage pricing is published — per-plan storage quotas and per-user prices on a public page, including what happens at the cap
